description: Engineered for Clean, Precise Drilling: The Bosch 30-piece X-Line TiN-coated set is designed for accurate and clean drilling in wood, metal, and masonry. It’s a reliable choice for both professionals and DIYers tackling daily or demanding tasks. High-Performance Titanium-Coated Metal Bits: BOSCH kit Includes 11 HSS-TiN metal drill bits (Ø 1.5–6.5 mm) for enhanced drilling speed, durability, and longer life. TiN coating improves heat resistance, delivering smooth results over extended use. Reliable Masonry and Wood Bits: Bosch 30-piece X-Line TiN-coated set comes with 4 masonry bits (Ø 4–7 mm) for fast removal and 4 wood bits (Ø 4–8 mm) with sharp cutting tips. Perfect for clean, tear-free holes in bricks, walls, and wooden surfaces. Versatile Screwdriving Range: Equipped with 10 screwdriver bits (PH, PZ, S, T) to match the most used screw types. Bosch tiN-coated set ensures you're ready for furniture assembly, electrical work, or general repairs. Compact and Durable Case: Housed in a strong, portable plastic case with window and printed card for easy identification. Keeps your tools secure, organized, and always ready for use on-the-go.
